verdict.rationale: Groq is an LLM inference API platform. Such a platform could plausibly offer versioned prompts, agents or workflows, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about versioning, reviewing or rolling back automations. Batch processing, tool use, remote MCP and the Responses API are execution features, not change-management for automations, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
